decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core cheese business, it can still be supported by existing resources and capabilities, so without clearer evidence of a sustained shortfall below aspiration we would keep it under review.

After several years the multi-variant spicy cheese line appears to add complexity without visible signs of becoming a strong part of the assortment, so it likely falls short of aspiration levels and should be discontinued.
This mild creamy soft cheese fits the established portfolio well and likely remains within the firm's tolerance range for acceptable performance, so we would continue it while monitoring results.
Because this washed-rind soft cheese is the most niche offering and has shown no visible momentum over time, it is the most likely to be judged below aspirations and have its resources reallocated.
